expr: [m_s, v_s] = ncx2stat(5, 2); [m_v, v_v] = ncx2stat([3 5 10], 2); [m_b, v_b] = ncx2stat(5, [0 1 5]); [m_lam0, v_lam0] = ncx2stat(5, 0); m_k0 = ncx2stat(0, 2); m_kneg = ncx2stat(-1, 2); m_lneg = ncx2stat(5, -1);
comment: Sig: [m, v] = ncx2stat(k, lambda). Non-central χ²: m = k+λ, v = 2(k+2λ). Vectorised. k<=0 / λ<0 => NaN. λ=0 reduces to central χ²(k).
